description: A wavefolder that bends a signal towards a square at one end of its travel and towards a spike at the other

params.text: Bends the shape of the signal, -1 at one end of its travel and +1 at the other, leaving it alone in the middle
Scales the signal before and after the bending, -1 to +1
Chooses the voltage the module works over, plus and minus 5V or plus and minus 10V
Takes the effect out of the circuit, fading rather than switching so nothing clicks

inputs.text: Added to the SCALE knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the SHAPE knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
A second signal mixed in to drive the bending, so another oscillator can shape the sound
A trigger here switches the voltage range
A trigger here takes the effect out of the circuit, and a second trigger puts it back

inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
